decisions.title: Rebuild frontend as Svelte 5 SPA with svelte-spa-router, TanStack Query, feature folders, and shared Zod schemas
decisions.rationale: The existing src/web/ frontend has accumulated state-based navigation, duplicated types/helpers, no design system, and does not feel native on mobile. A full rewrite with real URLs, feature-based organization, a reusable design system, and a typed API layer is more cost-effective than incremental fixes. Svelte 5 and Vite 6 are already project standards; TanStack Query solves cache/invalidation for dashboard and visits; svelte-spa-router gives real URLs with minimal backend changes; shared Zod schemas eliminate duplicated worker/web contracts.
decisions.consequences: Adds runtime deps including svelte-spa-router, @tanstack/svelte-query, bits-ui, lucide-svelte, clsx, tailwind-merge, and dev deps for PWA, ESLint, Prettier. Old src/web/pages/*, lib/api.ts, lib/router.ts, lib/role.ts, lib/visit.ts, lib/photo.ts, and components/Icon.svelte will be deleted in Phase H. Worker routes need to import request/response schemas from src/shared/schemas/* instead of redeclaring them inline. Two backend additions are required: GET /api/visits and /api/reports export.
